card.text: Explore Dike in 3D with its published shape model and documented physical size scale.

introduction.text: Published lightcurve reconstruction, scaled using a thermophysical size estimate. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Thermophysical volume-equivalent diameter 66.5 ± 0.9 km. The displayed pole differs by 1° from the fitted model family; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 33.25 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
